newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Moroccans remitted $1.16 bln in Jan-July 1996.
newsitem.headline: Moroccans remitted $1.16 bln in Jan-July 1996.

text.p: Moroccans living abroad remitted 10.1 billion dirhams ($1.16 billion) in the first seven months of the year, up 5.2 percent over the same period in 1995, the finance ministry said on Wednesday.
The remittances were 9.6 billion dirhams in the period of January-July 1995, the ministry said in a news bulletin.
More than 1.8 million Moroccans live abroad, 1.4 million of them in Europe, officials said.
Earlier, the Office des Changes regulatory bureau said expatriate remittances rose to $947 million in the first half of 1996, up 2.7 percent over the same period in 1995.
Expatriate remittances and tourism receipts are Morocco's main providers of foreign currency.
